'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2025 Cambodia–Thailand clashes]]
**[[Royal Cambodian Armed Forces|Cambodian]] and [[Royal Thai Armed Forces|Thai troops]] exchange fire near the [[Prasat Ta Muen Thom]] site near the [[Cambodia–Thailand border|border]]. Fourteen people are killed and 46 others are injured in Thailand. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c80p8z0y0eko (BBC News)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/7/24/live-at-least-2-killed-as-thai-cambodian-troops-clash-at-disputed-border (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Angara Airlines Flight 2311]]
**An [[Angara Airlines]] [[Antonov An-24]] operating as [[Angara Airlines Flight 2311]] en route to [[Tynda]] crashes into a [[forest]]ed area in [[Amur Oblast]], [[Russia]], killing all 48 occupants, including five children. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/jul/24/passenger-plane-missing-russia-far-east-an-24-angara (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/russian-plane-with-50-aboard-missing-amur-region-interfax-says-2025-07-24/ (Reuters)]
*At least 12 people are killed, several others are missing, and 157 are injured in an explosion at an [[ammunition depot]] in [[Maarrat Misrin]], [[Idlib Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://english.news.cn/20250725/7c59201ed56f4187adcf6ffaa886ae7c/c.html (Xinhua News Agency)] [https://apnews.com/article/syria-explosion-idlib-8764377a700af6bdda81a1106067fec6 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International recognition of Palestine]]
**[[French president]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] announces that [[France]] will recognize [[Palestine]] as a state starting September, citing reasons such as an immediate end to the [[Gaza war|war]] and helping the [[Gaza humanitarian crisis (2023–present)|humanitarian crisis]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250724-french-president-macron-says-france-will-recognize-palestine-as-a-state-in-september (France 24)] [https://apnews.com/article/france-recognize-palestine-state-macron-800ed63143f0653a7f215ad96f7038d3 (AP)]
*[[Norway–Russia relations]], [[Violations of non-combatant airspaces during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Norway]] reports that [[Russia]] has violated its [[airspace]] over [[Finnmark]] for the second time this year. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/norway-says-russia-violated-its-airspace-three-times-2025-2025-09-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Central African Republic Civil War]]
**The [[International Criminal Court]] convicts [[Patrice-Edouard Ngaïssona]] and [[Alfred Yekatom]], leaders of the [[Anti-balaka]] militia alliance, of multiple counts of [[war crimes]] and [[crimes against humanity]] and sentences them to 12 and 15 years in prison respectively for their roles in various massacres against civilians throughout the civil war in the [[Central African Republic]]. [https://apnews.com/article/international-court-war-crimes-central-african-republic-e0c65fc4ef65d107f54e296ac7214de4 (AP)]
*[[Hungary–Israel relations]], [[Hungary–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[Hungary]] bans [[Northern Ireland|Irish]] rap trio [[Kneecap (band)|Kneecap]] for three years ahead of a music festival, citing a national security threat over their alleged support for [[Hamas]] and [[Hezbollah]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/hungary-bans-anti-israel-rap-group-kneecap-from-entering-country-for-festival-gig/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
